structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions
Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

law.catch_line: Institutions receiving interest accruing on proceeds of land scrip
law.text: The annual accruing interest from the education fund resulting from the donation of lands by act of Congress on July 2, 1862, and the sale of such lands and the investment of the proceeds from such sale in state bonds by the Board of Education on February 7 and March 19, 1872, shall be paid one-third to Virginia State University and two-thirds to the University.
